annotations.title: Language detection: detect the language of a text

description: Detect which language a text is written in: the most likely language with its ISO 639-3 and 639-1 codes and English name, plus the next candidates with relative scores, using trigram statistics for 82 major languages (franc-min). Works best above about 20 characters; very short or mixed text returns und (undetermined). Local, no outside service. Use to route messages, pick a translation target or filter content by language. Example: text=Det här är en mening skriven på svenska om väder och resor.. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
